description: Ozel formlar ve form cevaplari: form listesi, cevap listesi, cevap detayi ve bir cevaba yanit yazma.

action.description: Yapilacak islem. Her action'in kendi zorunlu alanlari vardir; asagidaki aciklamalarda hangi alanin hangi action'a ait oldugu koseli parantez icinde belirtilir.

background_color.description: background color in HEX format, such as

body_color.description: text color in HEX format, such as

btn_color.description: button color in HEX format, such as

btn_operation.description: button operation. 1 for URL, 2 for Fonzip Related operation

btn_text_color.description: button text in HEX format, such as

footer_text_color.description: footer text color in HEX format, such as

has_association_logo.description: True if mail includes the logo of association

has_button.description: whether a button is added or not

make_refund.description: refund if there's a payment of form answer

membership_no.description: custom membership number you'd like to set, valid when membership_no_decision is custom

membership_no_decision.description: how to assign the new membership number - no: does not make any changes - auto: assigns the next available membership number incrementally - custom: sets your value

save_as_template.description: True if you want to save message as template

send_from_template.description: True if you want to send email from template

update_template.description: True if you want to overwrite message of template

archived.description: [list] true for archived records, null for normal records

end_date.description: [list_answers] Zorunlu: list_answers. End date filtering for transaction__complete_date or complete_date fields. Must be after start_date.

how_many.description: [list, list_answers] How many records should be listed

query.description: [list, list_answers] search parameter. start with - (minus) char to exclude searched text

start_date.description: [list_answers] Zorunlu: list_answers. Start date filtering for transaction__complete_date or complete_date fields. Must be before end_date.

status.description: [list_answers] answer status - answer: list answers - waiting_approval: list answers waiting approval - rejected: list rejected answers - refund: list refunds - failed: list failed answers

name: fonzip_forms
